verdict.rationale: First-party docs show SendGrid offers an Event Webhook that posts email event data to a URL you control, plus an Inbound Parse webhook that forwards parsed incoming email and attachments to a URL of your choice. Both give a clear way to subscribe to events by webhook. The evidence consists of short summary snippets rather than in-depth reference material. Missing for 10: documented event types and payload schema, webhook signature verification and retry behavior, API-based programmatic subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
